t001.title: Swap session token storage in the auth middleware
t001.u1: Swap the session token in the auth middleware to match the new policy. Rotate every 15 minutes, store in an httpOnly cookie. Don't break existing callers.
t001.u2: Good. Build the adapter first and add the tests up front.

a1.thinking: Find every withSession caller first, then weigh an adapter pattern to preserve the signature. The localStorage→cookie migration is fragile across SSR boundaries, so split server/client.
a1.text1: Let me lay out the plan. `withSession` currently reads the token from sessionStorage; to avoid breaking the 23 call sites we need to wrap it in an adapter.
a1.plan1: Introduce SessionAdapter (abstract over both sessionStorage and cookie)
a1.plan2: Add 15-minute rotation + httpOnly cookie issuance path
a1.plan3: Write 6 regression tests, verify all 23 callers

a2.text1: Added `SessionAdapter` and kept the `withSession` signature. 6 regression tests added, all passing.

modes.intro: Each mode bundles a system prompt, allowed tools, a sticky model, and a trust level. Built-in modes can be duplicated but not deleted.

trust.label: Trust dial
trust.desc1: Proposes diffs only. Never writes to the working tree. Best for paired-review work.
trust.desc2: Writes one file at a time, asks before each. Safe default for unfamiliar repos.
trust.desc3: Writes freely. Asks before running scripts or destructive commands.
trust.desc4: Writes and runs scripts without asking. Stops before push or merge.
trust.desc5: Pushes, comments, and merges if CI passes. Use only in scratch branches.
